name: Unbiased Score Distillation (USD) Rectification
definition: A rectification method to correct unconditional noise bias in diffusion models for novel view synthesis, combining unconditional noise prediction from a base model with conditional noise prediction from a fine-tuned model.
summary: Unbiased Score Distillation Rectification corrects noise bias in diffusion models by combining base and fine-tuned predictions, ensuring consistent novel views while preserving style and geometry.
